name: Dotted path steps
what: A row of light dots across a dark frame while the camera slowly pushes in; a dashed glowing line is drawn through them from the left, faster and faster, and every named dot gets its name the moment the line reaches it; the dots then turn to a second colour.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0 the dots are there and the camera starts a slow push-in (x1.25 by f104); from f14 the dashed line is drawn through them from the left edge, slowly at first and then faster and faster to f44; each name grows from nothing in 9 f (decelerating) as the line reaches its dot (f33, f38, f40); f64-f76 the dots turn from light to a second colour; then it holds to the end

tracks.name: push-in
tracks.what: the whole scene scales up about its centre (x1.25)
tracks.easing: slow start, almost linear, soft end (measured)

tracks.name: dashed line
tracks.what: the dashed glowing line is drawn through the dots from the left
tracks.easing: accelerating: slow start, then faster and faster (measured)

tracks.name: names
tracks.what: each name grows from nothing as the line reaches its dot

tracks.name: dots turn
tracks.what: the dots change from light to the second colour

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: everything still except the push-in tail (the film grain moves)
